en.name: jakegu1/vetagent
en.description: Pre-trade token check for AI agents that asks whether you could still sell. Sell simulation and buy/sell tax (Ethereum, BSC, Base), mint/freeze authority and holder concentration (Solana), liquidity depth, pair age and same-ticker impersonation, returned as one `low`/`medium`/`high`/`unknown` verdict with the signals behind it.
